services.value: Anatek Labs provides environmental analytical testing services including drinking water, private well water, public drinking water, wastewater/soil/compost testing, hazardous waste testing, PFAS/PFC testing using EPA methods, and food pathogen and microbiology testing. The site also lists testing for pesticides and herbicides, lead and copper, UCMR5, low level mercury, and methamphetamine (meth) among other contaminants.
